description_nl: 2026-10-07: when CBDT extends a due date by circular, s.234A interest still runs from the original date if the tax owed (after advance tax, TDS/TCS, reliefs) is over 1 lakh - as CBDT's extension orders (9/2021, 17/2021) say; Circular 07/2026 is silent, so the safer reading is kept. Otherwise from the extended date.
